design: THREE-HEADED HYDRA: Exactly THREE heads in a simple clearly separated fan. Head A at UPPER LEFT, head B at UPPER CENTER, head C at UPPER RIGHT. Only these THREE heads, all pointing RIGHT. Exactly THREE unbranched long necks each terminating in ONE head; all necks attach to ONE quadruped body. NO lower fourth head, NO extra faces. Arrange all THREE at same general height so they are countable. Olive dark-green bronze-scaled reptile, THREE narrow stern serpentine faces, ONE tail, FOUR legs, no wings. Body below the three long necks. All16poses keep exactly three heads: three closed-mouth alert, three recoiling, three lunging, three retreating; no head merging. Spacious figures no overlap.

Transparent empty background. Every subject entirely within its own equal cell, generous empty padding between figures. Figures must occupy no more than 65% of cell height, with generous transparent padding. No overlap between cells, no cropped horns, tails, wings or weapons.

Anchor the support point consistently in all cells, stable idle. ROW 4 (bottom): DODGE four frames, alert preparation, evasive duck or sidestep/backward lean appropriate to the species, lowest evasive pose, return to guard. Distinct from hurt and attack. No ghost copies or motion streaks.
Keep every frame FULL BODY and the same zoom. Transparent background with real alpha, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadows, no captions, no frame borders, no UI. This is high-detail NEW art, not enlarged old pixel art.
